svg.title: ObjectPool: a free stack of pre-allocated Orders
svg.text: ObjectPool: a free stack of pre-allocated Orders

g.text: Constructor: every node is free. top_ = 4 counts the free ones.
acquire(): return free_[--top_] = free_[3] = N3. top_ = 3. No call to new.
rest() fills N3 with the order
The order in N3 is filled or cancelled. release(N3): free_[top_++] = N3. top_ = 3.
N3 lands on top of the stack
The next acquire() returns N3 again: last in, first out. That memory is still in the CPU cache.
With top_ = 0, acquire() returns nullptr and rest() refuses the order. It never allocates.
pool empty → the order's qty is counted as expired
